cands.name: Julia Howard
cands.bio: Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, now representing District 77 (earlier District 79 and District 74). Works as an appraiser and realtor. Has chaired the House Finance and Banking committees and won re-election on November 3, 2026.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Julia Howard was born or raised, or when she moved to North Carolina. We found no sponsored bills, actions in office or stated positions on data centers, homestead taxes, land purchases, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys for 2020 through 2026, so there are no self-described campaign themes. We found no endorsements for 2024 or 2026, and no documented controversies or foreign ties.

cands.name: Sabrina Harris
cands.bio: Sabrina Harris was the Democratic nominee for North Carolina House District 77 in 2026. She advanced from a canceled primary and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Julia Howard. No occupation or office held was found in the sources available.

endorsements.text: Listed as endorsed or recommended by the Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy voter guide (Sway voting group by Tevin (Momala) Davis).

cands.gaps: We could not find where Sabrina Harris was born or raised, when she came to North Carolina, or what jobs she has held. She has not held public office, so there is no record of actions in office. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and we found no campaign site, interviews or questionnaires stating her positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. No news coverage or controversies about her were found.
